edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing caller-controlled privilege.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender when consuming allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the delegatecall function.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates init configuration.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batchSend.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTradeAddress.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender.
transfer returns the result of transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer's _to parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer's _value parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) as a pausable whitelist guard.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for both parties.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
Balance and allowance updates use unchecked subtraction operators.
_from parameter controls whose balance and sale counter are modified.
_to parameter receives the credited balance.
_value parameter is the amount debited and credited.
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor().
ensure grants a free pass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping.
ensure grants a free pass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure stores the derived pair address in the local _UNI variable.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition checks _saleNum against _onSaleNum[_from].
condition reads the per-address sale counter.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init assigns the scaled min sale to _minSale.
init assigns the scaled max sale to _maxSale.
init assigns saleNum to _saleNum.
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum.
token parameter scales into _minSale.
maxToken parameter scales into _maxSale.
setTradeAddress writes addr into the tradeAddress whitelist.
addr parameter becomes the new trade address.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend debits msg.sender and credits each _to in balanceOf.
batchSend stores the unchecked product in local total.
batchSend iterates the loop with local index i.
batchSend iterates over the _tos recipient array.
_value parameter determines per-recipient credit and the multiplication.
Constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply and decimals.
Constructor sets name.
Constructor sets symbol.
Constructor scales supply by 10**decimals.
Constructor reads msg.sender for ownership and initial supply.
delegate performs a raw delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the raw calldata for the delegatecall.
callOptionalReturn executes address(token).call(data).
callOptionalReturn decodes the optional return data into local returndata.
ERC20._transfer updates the private _balances mapping.
External token call can re-enter the calling contract before state finalization.
Delegatecall executes external code that can mutate this contract's owner and balances.

normalization_plan.reason: _from parameter of transferFrom is only meaningful as input to that function's balance/whitelist logic; fold it into the function node.
_to parameter of transferFrom is consumed solely by the transferFrom transfer logic.
_value parameter of transferFrom feeds directly into the unchecked balance arithmetic.
Parameter a is the direct target of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b is the calldata payload of the delegatecall.
_tos array is the loop input for the batchSend transfer operation.
_value multiplies _tos.length, producing the unchecked arithmetic operation.
_to from transfer is forwarded straight into transferFrom.
_value from transfer is forwarded straight into transferFrom.
addr is written directly to the tradeAddress whitelist state by setTradeAddress.
saleNum is assigned into _saleNum by init.
token is scaled and assigned into _minSale by init.
maxToken is scaled and assigned into _maxSale by init.
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication.
Loop index i exists only to drive batchSend's transfer loop.
Local _UNI is derived inside ensure() and used only for its whitelist comparison.
returndata is the local result of the low-level external call in callOptionalReturn.
